n_in.text: In this video, I'll show you how to load cash into your CoinZoom account.

n_four.text: Four quick steps: tap Deposit, tap CoinZoom Cash, pick a store, and show your barcode.

n_what.text: CoinZoom Cash lets you load cash at participating stores across the US, like Speedway, Stripes and 7-Eleven.

n_s1.text: Step one. In your Wallet, tap Deposit.

n_s3.text: Step three. Use the map to pick a store near you.

n_s3b.text: It only shows stores that take CoinZoom Cash.

n_s4.text: Step four. At the store, pull up your barcode, and ask the cashier to scan it.

n_tip.text: Your barcode has a timer, and the screen shows the fee and the limits, so read them first.

n_done.text: The cashier loads your cash and gives you a receipt. You're done!

n_recap2.text: You tapped Deposit, chose CoinZoom Cash, picked a store, and the cashier scanned your barcode.

hi.text: Hi, my name is MTG, Your Digital Architect.

n_thanks.text: Thank you for taking the time to watch this video.

pause.text: You can pause any step and follow along with me.

n_turn2.text: Simple, right? Now it's your turn.

every.text: Invited by someone else? Use their link. This video is for every team, so feel free to share it.

n_save.text: Save this video, so it's here when you need it.

n_share.text: Share it with someone who's ready to start.

n_we.text: We learn best when we teach others.

n_slog.text: It pays to pay attention, and take action.

o_fin.text: Quick reminder: none of this is financial advice.

o_thanks.text: Thank you for tuning in, and for every like, share, and comment.

o_massive.text: And thank yourself for taking massive action today to change your future!

o_best.text: I wish you nothing but the best, because YOU are the best.

o_see.text: See you on the next one.
